title: Card Tender Discount on Northgate Delivery & Installation Parts Kits
content:
A tender discount is taken off the kits' amount once on a Northgate Delivery & Installation installation appointment. It follows how the purchase being delivered was paid, as the purchase record under Northgate Purchases & Returns shows its tender:

| Purchase paid with | Discount off the kits' amount |
|---|---|
| The Northgate Visa | 10 percent |
| The Northgate Store Card | 5 percent |
| Any other tender | Nothing |

The kits' amount is the amount for the kits owed before rounding; the discount is a percentage of that amount, taken once.

## Tender questions

**Which tender counts?** The tender of the purchase being delivered.

**Hypothetical figure.** A kits' amount of $80.00 becomes $72.00 when the purchase was paid with the Northgate Visa, $76.00 with the Northgate Store Card and stays $80.00 when it was paid any other way.
